phases.name: Year 1
phases.subtitle: Explore
phases.description: Engineering & Chemistry Foundations — Build STEM literacy, explore chemical engineering careers, and develop laboratory skills.

milestones.label: Explore chemical engineering career pathways
milestones.description: Introduction to engineering disciplines with emphasis on chemical engineering applications in energy, pharmaceuticals, polymers, food processing, and environmental remediation.

milestones.label: Build calculus foundations for engineering
milestones.description: Functions, limits, derivatives, and introduction to integration. Mathematical foundation for mass and energy balances, reaction kinetics, and transport phenomena.

milestones.label: Master general chemistry for engineers
milestones.description: Atomic structure, chemical bonding, stoichiometry, thermochemistry, and equilibrium. Foundation for chemical reaction engineering and process chemistry.

milestones.label: Join AIChE student chapter
milestones.description: Join the American Institute of Chemical Engineers (AIChE) student chapter, NSBE, or SWE. Attend plant tours, industry speakers, and ChemE Car competition preparation.

milestones.label: Study physics foundations for engineering
milestones.description: Mechanics, thermodynamics, and waves. Students build the physics foundation for fluid mechanics, heat transfer, and process equipment design.

phases.name: Year 2
phases.subtitle: Engage
phases.description: Core Chemical Engineering Sciences — Master mass/energy balances, thermodynamics, and transport phenomena.

milestones.label: Master material and energy balances
milestones.description: Systematic application of conservation laws to chemical processes. Students solve complex material and energy balance problems for reacting and non-reacting systems, multiunit processes, and recycle streams.

milestones.label: Study chemical engineering thermodynamics
milestones.description: Laws of thermodynamics, equations of state, phase equilibria, and chemical equilibrium applied to industrial chemical processes. Students use thermodynamic software for process calculations.

milestones.label: Tour chemical plants and process facilities
milestones.description: Participate in AIChE-organized tours of chemical plants, refineries, and pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities in North Carolina. Connect classroom concepts to industrial practice.

milestones.label: Master fluid mechanics and transport phenomena
milestones.description: Momentum, heat, and mass transfer in chemical engineering systems. Students analyze pipe flow, heat exchangers, and mass transfer equipment used in global chemical manufacturing.

milestones.label: Study organic chemistry for chemical engineers
milestones.description: Organic reaction mechanisms, functional groups, and synthesis. Foundation for polymer engineering, pharmaceutical processing, and petrochemical applications.

phases.name: Year 3
phases.subtitle: Develop
phases.description: Advanced ChemE & Professional Experience — Master reaction engineering, process design, and complete internship.

milestones.label: Master chemical reaction engineering
milestones.description: Kinetics of chemical reactions, reactor design (batch, CSTR, PFR), catalysis, and reaction optimization. Students design reactor systems for industrial chemical processes.

milestones.label: Study process control and instrumentation
milestones.description: Feedback control systems, PID controllers, process dynamics, and instrumentation for chemical processes. Students design and tune control systems using simulation software.

milestones.label: Compete in AIChE Chem-E-Car or design competition
milestones.description: Design and build a chemically-powered vehicle for the AIChE Chem-E-Car competition. Develop teamwork, project management, and applied chemical engineering skills.

milestones.label: Complete summer chemical engineering internship
milestones.description: Secure and complete an internship at a chemical company, refinery, pharmaceutical manufacturer, or environmental engineering firm. Apply process engineering skills in an industrial setting.

milestones.label: Study process safety and environmental engineering
milestones.description: Process hazard analysis, risk assessment, environmental regulations (EPA, OSHA), and green engineering principles. Students conduct HAZOP studies and develop safety management systems.

phases.name: Year 4
phases.subtitle: Launch
phases.description: Capstone Design & Career Launch — Complete senior design project, prepare for PE exam, and launch engineering career.

milestones.label: Execute senior design capstone project
milestones.description: Complete a year-long process design project including process flow diagrams, equipment sizing, economic analysis, and safety review. Teams work with industry sponsors on real chemical process challenges.

milestones.label: Prepare for FE exam and professional licensure
milestones.description: Prepare for the NCEES Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) exam through review courses and practice exams. Begin the path toward Professional Engineer (PE) licensure.

milestones.label: Serve as peer mentor and AIChE chapter leader
milestones.description: Mentor underclassmen in chemical engineering coursework, lead AIChE chapter activities, and organize industry speaker events and plant tours.

milestones.label: Develop career placement portfolio
milestones.description: Assemble a career launch package including technical resume, design project portfolio, FE exam status, and documented professional network for chemical engineering positions.

milestones.label: Complete exit assessment and career activation
milestones.description: Complete the CoE Chemical Engineering Exit Assessment demonstrating competency across ABET outcomes. Finalize career activation documenting job offers, graduate admissions, or FE exam results.
